remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, March 1958." Completed in New York or Virginia before August move to Texas. Pictured in 1917 New York (291) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 6. Orientation differs from installation photograph. See cat. no. 85. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
